rule: Frozen native hourly BREAKOUT using previously completed daily breakout and hourly confirmation, existing stops/targets and scheduling. This is distinct from the five-minute PR3 opening-range strategy.
costs: Frozen swing8 fixture. Nominal per side 5bp for equities/ETFs and 35bp for crypto, plus USD1 per UTC calendar day per account. Stress doubles each. No cash yield.
endpoints: Log growth of a single funded account after all costs. Paired daily log increments: JOINT absolute, JOINT minus EQUITY_ETF, JOINT minus CRYPTO, JOINT minus CASH. Two scenarios, circular 5/20 day blocks, 20000 replicates, seed 319, local one-sided 0.05/16 bounds. Each book exclusion reruns sizing and shared constraints.
stop: Reject the full recipe on net <=0 or measured drawdown >8% in either scenario. If viable on reused history, require positive bounds in both cases and both block lengths for diagnostic evidence for the combined recipe; reject or withhold the relevant addition on a failed marginal comparison. Scarcity, concentration, unobserved fills and reused history prevent 8/10. Do not tune after the run.
